dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Not everyone from Snezhnaya attacks on sight! We've worked with people from Snezhnaya many times during our expeditions.

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: All I can say is that there are way too many factions in their ranks and there're good eggs and bad eggs everywhere... You get that, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: As for the merchants who sold me the gun... I feel that they're really good people!

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: ...Because the Fire-Water that they delivered along with the musket tasted both sincere and fiery!
